verdict.rationale: AgentMail runs a documented hosted MCP server that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft and attachment tools to any compatible client, and it also offers an OpenAPI-described API and a CLI. Agents can read and search threads, triage with labels and allow/block lists, create drafts for human review, and send messages. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of an external agent like Claude or ChatGPT running the full workflow, and no evidence it can connect to a user's existing mailbox (e.g. Gmail) rather than an AgentMail-hosted inbox.
